glossdef.p: A DITA Craft feature that shows a topic as a formatted page beside its source. The visual preview (the default) renders the topic itself as you type — no DITA-OT, no save — with keys, reuse and link titles resolved and bidirectional scroll synchronization; the DITA-OT preview shows real DITA-OT HTML5 output. Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+H.
